footnotes.footnote: On November 2, 2026, shares of Series A Non-Voting Convertible Preferred Stock, par value $0.001 per share ("Series A Preferred Stock"), of the Issuer automatically converted into shares of common stock, par value $0.001 per share (the "common stock"), of the Issuer, subject to certain beneficial ownership limitations set by each holder of Series A Preferred Stock. As a result of such conversion, the Reporting Persons ceased to beneficially own more than 10% of the outstanding common stock. Accordingly, the Reporting Persons are no longer subject to Section 16 in connection with their transactions in the equity securities of the Issuer and therefore will no longer report any such transactions on Form 4 or Form 5.

Coastlands Capital LP ("Coastlands") and Coastlands Capital GP LLC (the "General Partner") are the investment adviser and general partner, respectively, of Coastlands Capital Partners LP, a Delaware limited partnership (the "Partnership"). Coastlands Capital LLC ("Coastlands GP") is the general partner of Coastlands. Matthew Perry is the control person of Coastlands, the Partnership, Coastlands GP and the General Partner. The reporting persons are filing this Form 4 jointly, but not as members of a group, and each disclaims membership in a group. Each reporting person also disclaims beneficial ownership of common stock except to the extent of that person's pecuniary interest therein.
